cases.q: Can I return a helmet I've worn?
cases.answer: [1] You cannot return a helmet that has been worn due to hygiene reasons.

sources.where: page 1, Items we cannot accept back

cases.q: How many days do I have to return unused items?
cases.answer: You have 30 days to return unused items from the date of delivery or collection, as long as the item is in its original packaging with tags attached [1].

cases.q: Is there a fee to return a bike by courier?
cases.answer: Yes, a collection fee of £35 applies to bikes returned by courier if they meet the return criteria [1].

cases.q: How long does a refund take?
cases.answer: Refunds are made to the original payment method within 5 working days of the item reaching our warehouse [1].

cases.q: How long is the warranty on a carbon frame?
cases.answer: The warranty on a carbon frame is 3 years [1].

cases.q: Are worn brake pads covered by warranty?
cases.answer: No, normal wear and tear on tyres, chains, cassettes, brake pads and cables is not covered by the warranty [1].

sources.where: page 1, What the warranty does not cover

cases.q: When is an e-bike battery considered faulty?
cases.answer: An e-bike battery is considered faulty if it holds less than 60% of its original capacity within the 2-year warranty period [1].

cases.q: How much is a full service?
cases.answer: A full service at Kestrel Cycles costs £140 [1].

cases.q: What does an e-bike service cost?
cases.answer: An e-bike service at Kestrel Cycles costs £95 [1].

cases.q: Do club members get money off servicing?
cases.answer: Yes, members of the Kestrel Riders Club get 15% off all workshop labour [1].

cases.q: How long will you keep my bike after the service is finished?
cases.answer: We hold bikes free of charge for 14 days after the work is done; after that, a storage fee of £5 per day applies [1].

cases.q: How much is next day delivery?
cases.answer: Next-day delivery costs £9.95 when ordered before 2pm, Monday to Thursday [1].

cases.q: Do you deliver to Ireland?
cases.answer: No, we do not deliver to Ireland. We currently deliver to the UK, Ireland and the Channel Islands only. We do not ship bikes outside the UK mainland. [1]

cases.q: Is click and collect free?
cases.answer: Click and collect is free from any of our three stores [1].

cases.q: What time do you close on Sunday?
cases.answer: All three stores are open Sunday from 10am to 4pm [1].

cases.q: Where is your York shop?
cases.answer: Your York shop is located at 4 Micklegate [1].
